'''Radoslav Harman''' is a Slovak [[mathematician]] working in the area of [[optimal design]] of statistical experiments. He is currently a [[docent]] at [[Comenius University]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.iam.fmph.uniba.sk/ospm/Harman/ | title = Comenius University website of Dr Harman | accessdate=August 21, 2016}}</ref>

==Biography==
In 2004, Harman obtained PhD in statistics from [[Comenius University]], under the supervision of [[Andrej Pazman]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=128763  |accessdate=August 21, 2016}}</ref> He has published 30 research papers in the field of [[optimal design]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Comenius University website |url=http://www.iam.fmph.uniba.sk/ospm/Harman/research.htm  |accessdate=August 21, 2016}}</ref>
